title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery New England submits for review and approval of a Firm Transportation Agreement with the City of Boston, Boston Public Schools (Phase III).
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The department Approves the proposed Agreement. The Departmetn finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitivelysensitive, and therefore Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: James Connelly, Chairman; Commissioners W. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., and Deirdre K. Manning. (GC 02-01)
